text:
deploy-bot: Release candidate 'rc-2026-03' blocked: env parity check failed for service inference-core. Missing secret MODEL_S3_PREFIX in prod; staging has value. Preflight error: model storage prefix mismatch.

alice: Oh — that's the model cache prefix. staging is using s3://redwood-models/v2/ but prod is pointing at s3://redwood-models/ (no v2).

ben: Confirmed. Canary picked up v2 yesterday. Looks like prod's helm values override didn't include the new prefix.

claire: Who pushed the prod tag last night? @dmitri?

dmitri: That was me for a quick image tag bump, i didn't touch helm values. Could be a chart default or missing values-prod entry.

alice: deploy-bot suggests either pinning the image to the previous working tag or backfilling the prod secret. Which is safer inside the current change window?

ben: Backfilling the secret is faster. Need to check KMS key access from prod. Pinning image is safer if we want rollback without touching secrets.

ops-bot: Checklist: 1) Validate KMS access for prod env. 2) If backfilling, use sealed-secret workflow. 3) If pinning, prepare image tag and rollout command. Notify SRE if out-of-window.

claire: Also update release notes to document the model prefix change and canary results. Ops sign-off required either way.

dmitri: I can backfill a sealed secret now (have ops creds). Are we allowed to patch during the 24:00-02:00 change window?

alice: :thumbsup: Go ahead. I'll draft a rollback plan in case the model doesn't load: include kubectl command to pin image: `kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=ghcr.io/redwood/inference:2026-03-09` and steps to revert secret.

ben: Also add a short monitor: if model prefix is wrong we'll see elevated latency and 404s from modelstore. I'll add a trace alert and a runbook link.

deploy-bot: Release hold in place. To unblock: add secret MODEL_S3_PREFIX to prod OR set image pin label 'model-compatible-v1' on the deployment.

dmitri: Pushing sealed secret now via `secretsctl apply --env=prod --file=sealed-model-prefix.yaml`. ETA ~4m.

dmitri: Done. Secret created, rollout triggered (deployment/inference restarted). deploy-bot: please re-run preflight.

deploy-bot: Preflight re-check OK — model prefix present and sample canary request succeeded. Release unblocked, proceeding with canary rollout per change-window policy.
